headline: DET @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 4.19 at HOU 4.68, with a projected total of 8.86. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, Dillon Dingler, Kevin McGonigle, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Christian Vázquez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
